components.name: Mode Switch
components.description: Switch between current live tracks and the historical archive.
components.css: .ds-mode { background: #5bd6cf; color: #0b1214; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; min-height: 44px; padding: 6px 14px; font: 600 13px/1.2 Arial, sans-serif; text-align: left; } .ds-mode:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5bd6cf; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Search archive records by Chinese name, English name, number, or year.
components.html: <input class="ds-search" type="search" aria-label="查找档案" placeholder="中文名 / 英文名 / 编号" />
components.css: .ds-search { width: 100%; min-height: 41px; padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(204, 230, 225, 0.3); border-radius: 4px; background: #172527; color: #edf5f3; font: 400 13px/1.4 Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-search:focus { border-color: #5bd6cf; outline: 2px solid #5bd6cf; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Source Card
components.description: Dense provenance record for one agency snapshot.
components.css: .ds-source-card { border: 1px solid rgba(204, 230, 225, 0.16); border-top: 2px solid #f3786d; border-radius: 4px; padding: 14px; background: #172527; color: #edf5f3; } .ds-source-card small { display: block; color: #f3786d; font: 600 10px/1.2 monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-source-card strong { display: block; margin-top: 8px; font: 700 16px/1.2 Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-source-card em { color: #8da39f; font: 400 10px/1.2 monospace; } .ds-source-card p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: #c2d1ce; font: 400 12px/1.5 Arial, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: A dark operations desk for comparing moving weather evidence. Deep charcoal-green surfaces keep the map and data legible; cyan marks live observation, amber marks risk or comparison, and red/green states carry source and intensity meaning.
keyCharacteristics: Map-first monitoring layout with a fixed source comparison rail.
Dark tonal surfaces with a small, semantic status palette.
Mono labels for provenance and sans-serif Chinese content for scanning.
Fine borders and 4px/8px corners; no oversized decorative cards.

rules.name: The Map Is the Light Rule
rules.body: The map is the only bright field; surrounding UI stays dark so path and marker colors retain hierarchy.

rules.name: The Two-Layer Label Rule
rules.body: Pair a short mono label with a readable Chinese title; metadata never replaces the content title.

dos: Do keep source identity, observed/forecast meaning, and unavailable states visible in text.
Do reserve the large first viewport for the map and the primary monitoring task.
donts: Don't add decorative dashboards, gradients, or motion that compete with map reading.
Don't use color alone to communicate source health or storm strength.
